category.name: Technology
category.description: Perangkat, perangkat lunak, dan istilah digital.

words.definition: A machine or tool made for a particular purpose.
words.example: This app works on any Android device.
words.example_id: Aplikasi ini berjalan di perangkat Android apa pun.

words.definition: Programs that run on a computer.
words.example: We updated the software last night.
words.example_id: Kami memperbarui perangkat lunak tadi malam.

words.definition: To copy files from the internet to your device.
words.example: Download the file before you leave.

words.definition: A copy of data kept in case the original is lost.
words.example: Always keep a backup of your notes.

words.definition: To make something more modern or current.
words.example: Please update the app to the latest version.
words.example_id: Mohon perbarui aplikasi ke versi terbaru.

words.definition: To convert data into a code so others cannot read it.
words.example: The app encrypts every message.

words.definition: The amount of data that can be sent at one time.
words.example: Video calls use a lot of bandwidth.
words.example_id: Panggilan video memakai banyak lebar pita.

words.definition: A person who uses a product or service.
words.example: Every user has a personal profile.

words.definition: An important part or function of a product.
words.example: Dark mode is my favourite feature.
words.example_id: Mode gelap adalah fitur favorit saya.

words.definition: To find and fix errors in a program.
words.example: He spent the night debugging the app.
words.example_id: Dia sepanjang malam mencari kesalahan aplikasi itu.

words.definition: A set of steps a computer follows to solve a problem.
words.example: The app uses a simple sorting algorithm.
words.example_id: Aplikasi itu memakai algoritma pengurutan sederhana.

words.definition: A program designed for a phone or tablet.
words.example: This app works offline.

words.definition: A program used to visit websites.
words.example: Open the link in your browser.

words.definition: Servers on the internet used to store data.
words.example: All photos are saved to the cloud.

words.definition: Facts and numbers collected for analysis.
words.example: The app stores data on the device.

words.definition: An organised collection of information.
words.example: The words are kept in a local database.
words.example_id: Kata-kata disimpan dalam basis data lokal.

words.definition: A small useful electronic device.
words.example: He loves buying new gadgets.

words.definition: To put a program onto a device.
words.example: Install the update before restarting.

words.definition: Computers connected so they can share data.
words.example: The office network was down all morning.

words.definition: A secret word used to enter an account.
words.example: Use a long password for your account.
words.example_id: Gunakan kata sandi panjang untuk akunmu.

words.definition: A small program that adds features to another.
words.example: This plugin adds dark mode support.
words.example_id: Plugin ini menambahkan dukungan mode gelap.

words.definition: The flat surface where images appear.
words.example: The screen is too bright at night.
words.example_id: Layarnya terlalu terang di malam hari.

words.definition: A computer that provides services to other computers.
words.example: The server handles all sync requests.

words.definition: To make data the same on two devices.
words.example: The notes sync every five minutes.

words.definition: To change to a better or newer version.
words.example: You should upgrade to the latest version.
words.example_id: Kamu sebaiknya meningkatkan ke versi terbaru.

words.definition: Working without cables.
words.example: The cafe offers free wireless internet.
words.example_id: Kafe itu menyediakan internet nirkabel gratis.

words.definition: A store of data kept for quick access.
words.example: Clearing the cache fixed the problem.

words.definition: To enter a system with a username and password.
words.example: Log in with your email address.

words.definition: To restart a computer or device.
words.example: Reboot the phone if the app freezes.
words.example_id: Mulai ulang ponsel jika aplikasinya macet.

words.definition: The space where data is kept.
words.example: The app needs little storage space.
words.example_id: Aplikasi ini butuh sedikit ruang penyimpanan.

words.definition: A mistake in a program that causes problems.
words.example: The update introduced a small bug.

words.definition: Instructions written for a computer.
words.example: She reviewed the code carefully.

words.definition: A person who builds software.
words.example: The developer fixed the crash.

words.definition: The physical parts of a computer.

words.example_id: Aplikasi ini butuh perangkat keras modern.

words.definition: The part of a program you see and use.
words.example: The interface is simple and clean.

words.definition: Not connected to the internet.
words.example: All features work offline.

words.definition: Connected to the internet.
words.example: The course is available online.

words.definition: To move through content on a screen.
words.example: Scroll down to see more words.
words.example_id: Gulir ke bawah untuk melihat kata lain.

words.definition: Existing on a computer rather than physically.
words.example: We held a virtual meeting.

words.definition: The discovery of patterns in data.
words.example: The analytics show daily active users.

words.definition: To make a process run without manual work.
words.example: They automate the report every night.

words.definition: A tiny electronic component in devices.

words.example_id: Ponsel itu memakai cip yang lebih cepat.

words.definition: Protection of systems and data from attack.

words.definition: A screen that summarises information.

words.definition: To release software to users.
words.example: We deploy on Fridays.

words.definition: Using electronic technology.
words.example: Most people read digital news.

words.definition: Software built into a device.
words.example: Update the firmware to fix the bug.

words.definition: The delay before data starts to move.
words.example: Low latency matters for gaming.

words.definition: A system on which services run.
words.example: The app runs on one platform.
words.example_id: Aplikasi ini berjalan di satu platform.

words.definition: A device that detects changes.
words.example: The sensor measures light.

words.definition: Technology worn on the body.
words.example: Wearables track your steps.

words.definition: Using body features for identification.
words.example: The app supports biometric login.

words.definition: A short-range wireless connection.
words.example: Connect the speaker via Bluetooth.

words.definition: A program that answers questions automatically.
words.example: The chatbot handled the request.

words.definition: The marker showing where you type.
words.example: Place the cursor at the end.

words.definition: A small aircraft without a pilot.
words.example: The drone filmed the rice fields.

words.definition: A system that blocks unwanted network access.
words.example: The firewall blocked the request.

words.definition: The set of keys used for typing.
words.example: My keyboard is not working.

words.definition: A portable computer.
words.example: I write code on my laptop.

words.definition: A device that connects to the internet.
words.example: Restart the modem if the internet drops.
words.example_id: Mulai ulang modem jika internet putus.

words.definition: To tell someone about something.
words.example: The app notifies you when a word is due.
words.example_id: Aplikasi memberi tahu saat kata jatuh tempo.

words.definition: A device that directs network traffic.

words.example_id: Pindahkan router lebih dekat ke TV.

words.definition: The smallest dot on a screen.
words.example: The photo has six million pixels.
words.example_id: Foto itu punya enam juta piksel.
